comment: Just a little update. I didn't take profit when it was at 6$ (it was Capy's price target) thinking it'll go way higher. After the big dip I saw the sentiment for a big squeeze declining and got out at close yesterday. Could have made 400% but due to greed got 80% profit. Lesson learned. Hedgefunds won't let another GME happen.
